policy_presence.summary: Official generative AI guidance and scope boundaries for The University of Sheffield are retained in local candidate evidence pending independent presentation review.

ai_disclosure.summary: Permitted AI use may require Acknowledge/Describe/Evidence, or a school-specific alternative.

coursework.summary: Assignment AI permission varies: check school and module assessment criteria.

exams.summary: No university-wide AI-exam permission verified; obtain exam-specific instructions.

privacy_data_entry.summary: Do not put personal, private or confidential data in prompts; PGR researchers must never upload confidential, proprietary or personally identifiable data.

academic_integrity.summary: Presenting generated work as your own risks misconduct; disclosure does not cure unpermitted use.

approved_tools.summary: Google Gemini is institutionally supported and accessible to students and staff, but access does not grant assessment permission.

named_ai_services.summary: Named AI services for The University of Sheffield are retained as discovery records pending independent presentation review; service availability does not grant assessment permission.

teaching_guidance.summary: The Common Approach integrates GenAI literacy into undergraduate programmes, while modules retain discipline-specific decisions.

research_guidance.summary: PGRs must maintain original research and disclose AI-generated or modified material; thesis-specific use details require further verification.

security_procurement.summary: Staff productivity AI must comply with data protection; full procurement approval route remains to be verified.
